<thought>To answer the task we need a retrosynthetic template that converts an aromatic C‑H bond into a C‑Br bond (electrophilic aromatic bromination).  
I will search the template catalog for templates that form a halide (Br) and break a C‑H bond on an aromatic ring. Then I will retrieve the mapped reaction SMILES for that template and its template_id.  

First, search the catalog for templates applicable to a simple bromobenzene product (c1ccc(Br)cc1).
